children: The ChatGPT maker is taking funding pitches to lift its valuation to 13 digits. The company wants more, as it rides a boost from its new model. Leaving less upside for new investors, while safety and economic risks balloon, is a tough sell even by crazed AI standards.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jonathan Guilford on X and LinkedIn.
OpenAI has held conversations with investors about a new funding round that could value it at $1.2 trillion after they approached the company, the Financial Times reported on September 15.
The ChatGPT developer believes it should be valued at $1.5 trillion at least, the New York Times subsequently reported on September 16, given advances in its latest AI models.
